contradictions.description: The 2026-06-30 AP aging totals $20,920.01, while the trial balance reports Accounts Payable of $34,342.99. The $13,422.98 difference equals the unpaid remainder of opening payables, but that balance has no vendor-level item in the AP aging. This is a subledger-to-control-account discrepancy, although it does not prevent completion of the four requested tasks.

h05-accrual_schedule.reason: The May prepaid schedule and insurance contract uniquely establish the June opening balance, monthly straight-line amortization, and closing balance, while the GL confirms June amortization has not yet been booked.

h05-bank_rec.reason: The bank statement, cash ledger, and trial balance provide enough detail to match cleared transactions and identify outstanding checks, the deposit in transit, unrecorded bank fees, and unrecorded interest; both adjusted balances tie uniquely.

h05-journal_entries.reason: The payroll register, prepaid support, fixed-asset register, source bills, and GL establish the required payroll accrual and missing insurance amortization, confirm that June depreciation is already posted, and provide sufficient support to assess bill coding.

h05-variance_analysis.reason: June ledger activity can be adjusted for the checklist close entries and compared with the June budget. Source bills identify the specific unbudgeted one-off initiatives driving the material expense variances; materiality requires ordinary professional judgment but does not make the task indeterminate.
